column4: Visit note | 2025-09-22 12:30 PM | Dr. Ishrat Jahan, Psychiatry | Patient: Sultana Akand, 60, female. Mrs. Akand returns for review, reporting continued poor sleep, feeling restless, and persistent muscle tension. Her symptoms have been worse since experiencing job insecurity at a company in Rangpur. She works as a shopkeeper. She has a known history of Bronchial asthma. She denies palpitations, low mood, or waking breathless at night. On examination: GAD-7 score 14, BP 115/80 mmHg, pulse 86 bpm, weight 70 kg. Chest is clear on auscultation. Assessment: Generalized anxiety disorder. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to practise slow breathing daily, reduce tea and coffee, and start counselling sessions. Follow-up in 4 weeks.
